summary: Practise digital-payment fraud assessment, alert triage, and case workflows. Explore the five-day course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Digital financial services fraud training helps analysts, investigators, and payments teams assess fraud risks and handle suspicious-transaction cases. Participants practise mapping agent and merchant risks, prioritizing monitoring alerts, and documenting evidence and reimbursement decisions, with exercises in account-takeover triage and case workflows. The syllabus also covers ISO 31000-informed assessment, relevant ISO 20022 payment-message concepts, and operational limits of AI-assisted detection.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who investigate, monitor, prevent, or oversee fraud across digital payments and financial services. It suits people who need practical workflows for cases that cross channels, customer groups, and organizational boundaries.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with digital payments, financial-services operations, fraud review, or customer-protection work is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel or compatible spreadsheet software for the dataset exercises.
